summary: Build an online shopping and delivery app with a storefront for browsing items, placing orders, and tracking deliveries.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Minimal modern delivery app logo, flat vector style, warm palette (shop-logo.dim_512x512.png)
- Storefront hero illustration showing shopping bag and delivery scooter, clean flat illustration, warm palette (store-hero.dim_1600x600.png)

existing_features.title: Implement Internet Identity sign-in and a basic authenticated user session so each order is associated with a specific user principal.
Create a storefront UI where users can browse products, search by name, filter by category, and view a product detail page.
Implement a client-side cart with add/remove/update quantity, cart persistence for the current session, and an order summary (subtotal and item count).
Create a checkout UI that collects delivery address and contact phone, shows the order summary, and places an order through the backend.

Implement delivery tracking statuses and an order tracking UI. Statuses must include at minimum: Placed, Preparing, Out for delivery, Delivered, Cancelled. Include a simple status timeline on the order detail view.
Add core navigation and pages: Storefront, Cart, Checkout, My Orders, Order Detail. Ensure routing and empty states are user-friendly and in English.
Apply a cohesive visual theme across the app (colors, typography, spacing, component styles) suitable for a modern grocery/retail delivery experience, and keep it consistent across all pages.
Render the generated images (logo and hero illustration) as static assets from frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the UI.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create an online shopping and delivery app (browse items, place orders, track deliveries)
Create backend product catalog support with a small default set of products, including: id, name, description, price, category, image URL (optional), and availability (in stock/out of stock).

Implement backend order creation and storage. An order must include: orderId, user principal, line items (productId, name snapshot, unit price snapshot, quantity), delivery address, contact phone, createdAt timestamp, and status.
Add a minimal admin-only capability (restricted to a configured list of principals in code) to update an order’s status to support simulated delivery progress.

projectName: Online shopping & delivery app (storefront, orders, delivery tracking)
